children: 2332 GMT - Australian homebuilder Mirvac needs a big 2H to achieve annual guidance for residential settlements, says UBS. Mirvac logged 291 settlements in 1Q, while keeping its target of 2,800-3,100 settlements in FY 2027 unchanged. "We are watching sales momentum and cancellation rates closely," says analyst Cody Shield. One positive for investors: Mirvac has a track record of leaning into 2H to achieve guidance. UBS points out that it had 68% and 61% skews to 2H in FY 2025 and FY 2026, respectively. Mirvac Needs Big 2H to Hit Settlement Goal But Has Form — Market Talk

2330 GMT [Dow Jones]--Australian homebuilder Mirvac needs a big 2H to achieve annual guidance for residential settlements, says UBS. Mirvac logged 291 settlements in 1Q, while keeping its target of 2,800-3,100 settlements in FY27 unchanged. "We are watching sales momentum and cancellation rates closely," says analyst Cody Shield. One positive for investors: Mirvac has a track record of leaning into 2H to achieve guidance. UBS points out that it had 68% and 61% skews to 2H in FY25 and FY26, respectively. UBS retains a neutral call and A$1.99/share price target on Mirvac, which is down 0.8% at A$1.805 today.  (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
